content.text:
The drawing shows an ethyl ester, C(=O)OEt, whose carbonyl carbon is attached to a C(=CH2) carbon. That carbon is bonded to a CH carrying a phenyl group (the wavy bond marks undefined stereochemistry), and this CH is also bonded to CH2–NO2.

The skeleton is therefore ethyl 2-methylene-3-phenyl-4-nitrobutanoate.

Because the wavy bond means the stereochemistry is undefined, the SMILES carries no stereo marks.

SMILES: CCOC(=O)C(=C)C(c1ccccc1)C[N+](=O)[O-]
